name: pinned-cli-reference-in-test-fixtures
description: When a repo cuts over from a reference CLI to its own reimplementation but must keep proving compat, pin the reference as a test FIXTURE instead of relying on PATH: a wrapper script + package.json/bun.lock in tests/fixtures/<ref>/ running the exact pinned version under its runtime, an env override (SEEDS_COMPAT_SD) for alternates, a --version assert to catch stale provisioning, and skip-with-note (stderr) when unprovisioned so plain CI stays green. Document provisioning (bun install) in the fixture README. Applied in crates/seeds/tests/fixtures/sd-reference for sd 0.5.15 (seed seeds-3791).

In the seeds run sandbox (clone contract /workspace/seeds -> /repos/denkhaus/seeds), file-tool writes (write_file/edit_file) leave mtime 1970-01-01 on created/edited files. Cargo then considers every artifact eternally fresh: a stale test binary or bin target is silently re-executed, re-emitting OLD failure text after source fixes (run 01M33374S3J9BC6M1FFTNWWAP9, seeds-25b5: three blind re-runs of a differential test before diagnosis).
resolution: After every file-tool edit to Rust sources, touch the edited files in the same shell call as the build/test; when a fix 'did not take effect', stat mtimes and force a rebuild before re-diagnosing.

description: In the seeds run sandbox (clone contract /workspace/seeds -> /repos/denkhaus/seeds), file-tool writes (write_file/edit_file) leave mtime 1970-01-01 on created/edited files. Cargo then considers every artifact eternally fresh: a stale test binary or bin target is silently re-executed, re-emitting OLD failure text after source fixes (run 01M33374S3J9BC6M1FFTNWWAP9, seeds-25b5: three blind re-runs of a differential test; reconfirmed run 01M336MYEF1R5C1JMC6WHFTCQY, seeds-540e). touch alone is NOT reliable; cargo clean -p <crate> reliably forces the rebuild. Always suspect a stale binary when a just-fixed assertion fails identically.
resolution: cargo clean -p <touched-crate>, then rerun; full verify green afterward
